source.text: וַיְהִ֡י בְּיוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְהָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וַיִּמְשָׁחֵ֖ם וַיְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was on [the] day of finishing Moses to set up the tabernacle, and he anointed it and consecrated it and all its articles, and the altar and all its articles, and he anointed them and consecrated them,

en.L: And it came about on the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, and anointed it and consecrated it and all its articles, and the altar and all its articles, and anointed them and consecrated them,
en.B: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, when he had anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, and had anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils,
en.R: Moses finished setting up the tabernacle. He anointed it with oil and set it apart for God, together with everything used in it. He did the same for the altar and all the things used with it.

es.L: Y sucedió el día en que Moisés terminó de levantar el tabernáculo, y lo ungió y lo consagró con todos sus utensilios, y el altar con todos sus utensilios, y los ungió y los consagró,
es.B: El día en que Moisés terminó de levantar el tabernáculo, cuando ya lo había ungido y consagrado junto con todo su mobiliario, y había ungido y consagrado el altar y todos sus utensilios,
es.R: Moisés terminó de levantar el tabernáculo. Lo ungió con aceite y lo apartó para Dios, junto con todo lo que se usaba en él. Hizo lo mismo con el altar y con todas las cosas que se usaban con él.

fr.L: Et il advint, le jour où Moïse eut fini de dresser la Demeure, et l’eut ointe et consacrée, ainsi que tous ses objets, et l’autel et tous ses objets, et les eut oints et consacrés,
fr.B: Le jour où Moïse eut fini de dresser la Demeure, après l’avoir ointe et consacrée avec tout son mobilier, et après avoir oint et consacré l’autel et tous ses ustensiles,
fr.R: Moïse a fini de dresser la Demeure. Il l’a ointe d’huile et l’a mise à part pour Dieu, avec tout ce qui servait à l’intérieur. Il a fait de même pour l’autel et pour tous les objets qui servaient avec lui.

sw.L: Ikawa siku ile Musa alipomaliza kuisimamisha maskani, akaipaka mafuta na kuitakasa pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, na madhabahu pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, akavipaka mafuta na kuvitakasa,
sw.B: Siku ile Musa alipomaliza kuisimamisha maskani, akiwa ameipaka mafuta na kuitakasa pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote, na kuipaka mafuta na kuitakasa madhabahu pamoja na vyombo vyake vyote,
sw.R: Musa alimaliza kuisimamisha maskani. Aliipaka mafuta na kuitenga kwa ajili ya Mungu, pamoja na kila kitu kilichotumika ndani yake. Alifanya vivyo hivyo kwa madhabahu na kwa vitu vyote vilivyotumika pamoja nayo.

decisions.choice: a time clause that runs on into verse 2: on the day Moses finished ..., the leaders brought offerings
decisions.reason: The verse opens with "and it came about on the day" and lists what Moses did that day; the main statement, the leaders' gifts, comes in verse 2. "On the day" can mean "at the time when" (Genesis 2:4): the leaders' offerings for the altar were spread over twelve days (verses 11-83).

decisions.choice: the day the tabernacle was set up: the first day of the first month of the second year
decisions.reason: Exodus 40:17-33 tells of this day, and Exodus 40:9-11 and Leviticus 8:10-11 of the anointing. It was a month before the census that opens the book, which began on the first day of the second month (1:1). The chapter goes back in time to tell what the leaders gave when the tabernacle was first set up.

decisions.choice: anointed and consecrated: smeared with the holy oil and so made holy, set apart for God's use
decisions.reason: The anointing oil was made for this purpose (Exodus 30:22-29). Whatever it touched became holy and could be used only in God's service.

decisions.choice: anointed it with oil and set it apart for God
decisions.reason: Readable says what anointing used and what consecrating means, and keeps verse 1 as sentences of its own. It ties the two verses together with "On that day" in verse 2.

decisions.choice: passé simple and passé antérieur at Literal and Balanced ("eut fini", "présentèrent"); passé composé at Readable ("a fini", "ont apporté")
decisions.reason: As the French style guide sets for narrative: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the passé composé of spoken and school French. The LORD's words keep the future or the imperative.

source.text: וַיַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַמַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־הַפְּקֻדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and brought near [the] leaders of Israel, heads of [the] house of their fathers; they [were the] leaders of the tribes, they [were] the ones standing over the counted [ones].

en.L: and the leaders of Israel, the heads of the house of their fathers, brought [offerings]; they [were] the leaders of the tribes, they [were] the ones standing over those counted.
en.B: the leaders of Israel, the heads of their ancestral families, brought offerings. They were the leaders of the tribes, the men who had been in charge of those who were counted.
en.R: On that day the leaders of Israel brought offerings. They were the heads of the families and the leaders of the tribes. They had been in charge of counting the people.

es.L: y presentaron [ofrendas] los jefes de Israel, las cabezas de la casa de sus padres; ellos [eran] los jefes de las tribus, ellos [eran] los que estaban al frente de los alistados.
es.B: los jefes de Israel, jefes de sus familias, presentaron ofrendas. Eran los jefes de las tribus, los que habían estado a cargo de los alistados.
es.R: Ese día, los jefes de Israel trajeron ofrendas. Eran los jefes de las familias y de las tribus. Ellos habían dirigido el censo del pueblo.

fr.L: et les chefs d’Israël, les chefs de la maison de leurs pères, présentèrent [des offrandes] ; ils [étaient] les chefs des tribus, ils [étaient] ceux qui se tenaient à la tête des recensés.
fr.B: les chefs d’Israël, chefs de leurs familles, présentèrent des offrandes. C’étaient les chefs des tribus, ceux qui avaient eu la charge des recensés.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, les chefs d’Israël ont apporté des offrandes. Ils étaient les chefs des familles et les chefs des tribus. C’étaient eux qui avaient dirigé le recensement du peuple.

sw.L: viongozi wa Israeli, wakuu wa nyumba ya baba zao, wakaleta [sadaka]; wao [ndio waliokuwa] viongozi wa makabila, wao [ndio] waliosimamia walioandikishwa.
sw.B: viongozi wa Israeli, wakuu wa jamaa zao, walileta sadaka. Hao ndio waliokuwa viongozi wa makabila, watu waliokuwa wamewasimamia wale walioandikishwa.
sw.R: Siku hiyo viongozi wa Israeli walileta sadaka. Walikuwa wakuu wa jamaa na viongozi wa makabila. Ndio waliosimamia kuhesabiwa kwa watu.

decisions.choice: brought near: brought offerings, without an object here
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for presenting an offering at the sanctuary (Leviticus 1:2). It has no object in this verse; verse 3 says what the leaders brought.

decisions.choice: the leaders of Israel, the heads of their ancestral families: the twelve tribal leaders
decisions.reason: These are the men named in 1:5-16, one from each tribe, who helped Moses and Aaron with the census. A "house of fathers" is a family traced through the father's line, the unit by which the tribes were counted (1:2).

decisions.choice: standing over those counted: in charge of the census
decisions.reason: To "stand over" a group is to have charge of it. "Those counted" are the men registered in the census of chapter 1 (1:44).

decisions.choice: On that day
decisions.reason: Verse 2 completes the time clause of verse 1. Readable, which ends verse 1 with a full stop, adds "On that day" to keep the link.

source.text: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וֹר לְאֶחָ֑ד וַיַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought their offering before Yahweh, six carts of covering and two [and] ten oxen, a cart for two of the leaders and an ox for one, and they brought them near before the tabernacle.

en.L: And they brought their offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, six covered carts and twelve oxen, a cart for [every] two of the leaders and an ox for each one; and they presented them before the tabernacle.
en.B: They brought their offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: six covered carts and twelve oxen, one cart for every two leaders and an ox from each one. They presented them in front of the tabernacle.
en.R: They brought their offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: six carts with covers and twelve oxen. Each pair of leaders gave one cart, and each leader gave one ox. They brought these to the front of the tabernacle.

es.L: Y trajeron su ofrenda delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: seis carretas cubiertas y doce bueyes, una carreta por cada dos de los jefes y un buey por cada uno; y los presentaron delante del tabernáculo.
es.B: Trajeron su ofrenda delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: seis carretas cubiertas y doce bueyes, una carreta por cada dos jefes y un buey de parte de cada uno. Los presentaron delante del tabernáculo.
es.R: Trajeron su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: seis carretas con toldo y doce bueyes. Cada pareja de jefes dio una carreta, y cada jefe dio un buey. Los llevaron frente al tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et ils apportèrent leur offrande devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : six chariots couverts et douze bœufs, un chariot pour deux des chefs et un bœuf pour chacun ; et ils les présentèrent devant la Demeure.
fr.B: Ils apportèrent leur offrande devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : six chariots couverts et douze bœufs, un chariot pour deux chefs et un bœuf de la part de chacun. Ils les présentèrent devant la Demeure.
fr.R: Ils ont apporté leur offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : six chariots couverts d’une bâche et douze bœufs. Chaque paire de chefs a donné un chariot, et chaque chef a donné un bœuf. Ils les ont amenés devant la Demeure.

sw.L: Wakaleta sadaka yao mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, magari sita yenye vifuniko na ng'ombe kumi na wawili, gari moja kwa [kila] viongozi wawili na ng'ombe mmoja kwa kila mmoja; wakavileta mbele ya maskani.
sw.B: Walileta sadaka yao mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: magari sita yenye vifuniko na ng'ombe kumi na wawili, gari moja kwa kila viongozi wawili na ng'ombe mmoja kutoka kwa kila mmoja. Wakavileta mbele ya maskani.
sw.R: Walimletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yao: magari sita yaliyofunikwa juu na ng'ombe kumi na wawili. Kila viongozi wawili walitoa gari moja, na kila kiongozi alitoa ng'ombe mmoja. Walivileta mbele ya maskani.

decisions.choice: carts of covering: covered carts
alternatives: wagons of a particular kind, or litters
decisions.reason: The word with "carts" is rare. It is usually taken to mean a cover or roof, carts with a covering to protect the load. Isaiah 66:20 uses the same word in a list of ways to travel, which has led some to think of a kind of litter or wagon.

decisions.choice: a cart for two of the leaders and an ox for each one: the twelve leaders shared the six carts, two to a cart, and each gave one ox
decisions.reason: Six carts and twelve oxen is one pair of oxen to pull each cart, given by the twelve leaders together.

decisions.choice: before Yahweh: at the sanctuary where the LORD was present
decisions.reason: "Before the LORD" here means at the tabernacle, as the end of the verse says. A gift brought there was a gift to God himself, before it was handed to the Levites (verses 5-6).

decisions.choice: "carretas cubiertas" (L, B), "carretas con toldo" (R)
decisions.reason: "Carreta" is the long wagon drawn by oxen, which these were (m2); "carro" (Genesis 45) is also used today for a car in much of Latin America. Readable names the cover plainly, an awning ("toldo").

decisions.choice: "chariots couverts"
decisions.reason: A French "chariot" is a four-wheeled farm wagon, which is what these ox-drawn carts were (m1); "charrette" suggests a small two-wheeled cart. Nothing here is a war chariot. Readable says what the cover was, a canvas ("bâche").

decisions.choice: "magari yenye vifuniko" (L, B), "magari yaliyofunikwa juu" (R)
decisions.reason: "Gari" is any wheeled vehicle, as in Genesis 45; the oxen given with them (verse 3) show they were ox-drawn carts. The rare word with them is read as a cover (m1).

sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa,

decisions.choice: the LORD's answer to a gift no one had asked for
decisions.reason: The leaders brought the carts and oxen of their own accord (verse 3). The LORD now tells Moses to accept them and what they are for (verse 5).

source.text: קַ֚ח מֵֽאִתָּ֔ם וְהָי֕וּ לַעֲבֹ֕ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִ֥י עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Take from them, and they will be for serving the service of [the] tent of meeting, and you will give them to the Levites, a man according to [the] mouth of his service.

en.L: "Take [them] from them, and they shall be for doing the service of the tent of meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, each one according to his service."
en.B: "Accept these from them, so that they may be used for the work of the tent of meeting. Give them to the Levites, to each as his work requires."
en.R: "Accept these gifts from them. They are to be used for the work of the meeting tent. Give them to the Levites, to each group as it needs them for its work."

es.L: «Toma[los] de ellos, y serán para hacer el servicio de la Tienda del Encuentro; y los darás a los levitas, a cada uno según su servicio».
es.B: «Acepta estas cosas de ellos, para que se usen en el trabajo de la Tienda del Encuentro. Dáselas a los levitas, a cada uno según lo requiera su trabajo».
es.R: «Acepta estos regalos de ellos. Se usarán en el trabajo de la Tienda del Encuentro. Dáselos a los levitas, a cada grupo según lo que necesite para su trabajo».

fr.L: « Prends[-les] d’auprès d’eux, et ils serviront à accomplir le service de la tente de la Rencontre ; et tu les donneras aux Lévites, à chacun selon son service. »
fr.B: « Accepte ces dons de leur part : ils serviront au travail de la tente de la Rencontre. Donne-les aux Lévites, à chacun selon ce que demande son travail. »
fr.R: « Accepte ces cadeaux de leur part. Ils doivent servir au travail de la tente de la Rencontre. Donne-les aux Lévites, à chaque groupe selon ce dont il a besoin pour son travail. »

sw.L: "Vichukue kutoka kwao, navyo vitakuwa kwa ajili ya kufanya huduma ya Hema la Kukutania; nawe uwape Walawi [vitu hivyo], kila mmoja kulingana na huduma yake."
sw.B: "Pokea vitu hivi kutoka kwao, vitumike kwa kazi ya Hema la Kukutania. Uwape Walawi, kila mmoja kama kazi yake inavyohitaji."
sw.R: "Pokea zawadi hizi kutoka kwao. Zitatumika kwa kazi ya Hema la Kukutania. Uwape Walawi, kila kundi kulingana na mahitaji ya kazi yake."

decisions.choice: the service of the tent of meeting: the Levites' work of taking down, carrying and setting up the tabernacle
decisions.reason: Chapter 4 gives each Levite clan its share of this work on the march (4:1-33). The carts and oxen were for moving the tent and its parts.

decisions.choice: each according to the mouth of his service: to each as his work requires
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of" means "in the measure of" or "as ... requires". Verses 7-9 show what this meant: each clan received carts by the size of its load.

decisions.choice: according to his service
decisions.reason: Literal leaves out "the mouth of", which in this phrase means only "as much as"; the idiom is explained in the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: to each group
decisions.reason: "Each one" here means each part of the Levites, which received carts clan by clan (verses 7-8). Readable says "group" so that the gifts are not thought of as given to every single Levite.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־הָעֲגָלֹ֖ת וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֑ר וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Moses the carts and the oxen, and he gave them to the Levites.

en.L: And Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
en.B: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
en.R: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.

es.L: Y tomó Moisés las carretas y los bueyes, y los dio a los levitas.
es.B: Así pues, Moisés tomó las carretas y los bueyes y se los dio a los levitas.
es.R: Entonces Moisés tomó las carretas y los bueyes y se los dio a los levitas.

fr.L: Et Moïse prit les chariots et les bœufs, et les donna aux Lévites.
fr.B: Moïse prit donc les chariots et les bœufs et les donna aux Lévites.
fr.R: Moïse a donc pris les chariots et les bœufs, et il les a donnés aux Lévites.

sw.B: Basi Musa akachukua magari na ng'ombe, akawapa Walawi.
sw.R: Basi Musa alichukua magari na ng'ombe, akawapa Walawi.

decisions.choice: Moses does as he was told
decisions.reason: The two verbs answer the two commands of verse 5: "take" and "give". Verses 7-9 say how he divided the gifts.

source.text: אֵ֣ת׀שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן כְּפִ֖י עֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Two of the carts and four of the oxen he gave to [the] sons of Gershon, according to [the] mouth of their service.

en.L: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
en.B: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required.
en.R: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Levites of Gershon's family, because they needed them for their work.

es.L: Dos carretas y cuatro bueyes dio a los hijos de Gersón, según su servicio.
es.B: Dio dos carretas y cuatro bueyes a los gersonitas, según lo requería su trabajo.
es.R: Dio dos carretas y cuatro bueyes a los levitas de la familia de Gersón, porque los necesitaban para su trabajo.

fr.L: Deux chariots et quatre bœufs, il les donna aux fils de Guershon, selon leur service.
fr.B: Il donna deux chariots et quatre bœufs aux Guershonites, selon ce que demandait leur travail.
fr.R: Il a donné deux chariots et quatre bœufs aux Lévites de la famille de Guershon, parce qu’ils en avaient besoin pour leur travail.

sw.L: Magari mawili na ng'ombe wanne aliwapa wana wa Gershoni, kulingana na huduma yao.
sw.B: Aliwapa Wagershoni magari mawili na ng'ombe wanne, kama kazi yao ilivyohitaji.
sw.R: Aliwapa Walawi wa ukoo wa Gershoni magari mawili na ng'ombe wanne, kwa sababu waliyahitaji kwa kazi yao.

decisions.choice: the sons of Gershon: the Levite clans that carried the tent's fabrics
decisions.reason: The Gershonites carried the curtains of the tabernacle, its coverings, the screens and the hangings of the courtyard (4:24-26). Their load was lighter than Merari's, so they received half as many carts (verse 8).

decisions.choice: the Gershonites / the Levites of Gershon's family
decisions.reason: "Sons of Gershon" names a group of clans descended from Gershon, son of Levi (3:17-21), not his own sons. Literal keeps "sons of".

source.text: וְאֵ֣ת׀אַרְבַּ֣ע הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַבָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י כְּפִי֙ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And four of the carts and eight of the oxen he gave to [the] sons of Merari, according to [the] mouth of their service, by [the] hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

en.L: And four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
en.B: And he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
en.R: He gave four carts and eight oxen to the Levites of Merari's family, because they needed them for their work. Ithamar son of Aaron the priest was in charge of them.

es.L: Y cuatro carretas y ocho bueyes dio a los hijos de Merari, según su servicio, bajo la mano de Itamar hijo de Aarón, el sacerdote.
es.B: Y dio cuatro carretas y ocho bueyes a los meraritas, según lo requería su trabajo. Estaban bajo la dirección de Itamar hijo de Aarón, el sacerdote.
es.R: Dio cuatro carretas y ocho bueyes a los levitas de la familia de Merari, porque los necesitaban para su trabajo. El sacerdote Itamar, hijo de Aarón, estaba a cargo de ellos.

fr.L: Et quatre chariots et huit bœufs, il les donna aux fils de Merari, selon leur service, sous la main d’Ithamar fils d’Aaron, le prêtre.
fr.B: Et il donna quatre chariots et huit bœufs aux Merarites, selon ce que demandait leur travail. Ils étaient sous la direction d’Ithamar fils d’Aaron, le prêtre.
fr.R: Il a donné quatre chariots et huit bœufs aux Lévites de la famille de Merari, parce qu’ils en avaient besoin pour leur travail. Le prêtre Ithamar, fils d’Aaron, les dirigeait.

sw.L: Na magari manne na ng'ombe wanane aliwapa wana wa Merari, kulingana na huduma yao, chini ya mkono wa Ithamari mwana wa Haruni, kuhani.
sw.B: Tena aliwapa Wamerari magari manne na ng'ombe wanane, kama kazi yao ilivyohitaji. Walikuwa chini ya uongozi wa Ithamari mwana wa Haruni, kuhani.
sw.R: Aliwapa Walawi wa ukoo wa Merari magari manne na ng'ombe wanane, kwa sababu waliyahitaji kwa kazi yao. Kuhani Ithamari mwana wa Haruni ndiye aliyewasimamia.

decisions.choice: the sons of Merari: the Levite clans that carried the tent's frame
decisions.reason: The Merarites carried the frames, bars, posts and bases of the tabernacle and its courtyard, with their pegs and cords (4:31-32), the heaviest load, so they received twice as many carts as the Gershonites.

decisions.choice: under the hand of Ithamar: under his direction
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" means under someone's charge. Ithamar the priest oversaw the work of both the Gershonites and the Merarites (4:28, 33), so the phrase may cover verse 7 as well as this verse.

decisions.choice: the Merarites / the Levites of Merari's family
decisions.reason: As in verse 7, "sons of Merari" names the clans descended from Merari, son of Levi (3:20, 33).

source.text: וְלִבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לֹ֣א נָתָ֑ן כִּֽי־עֲבֹדַ֤ת הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם בַּכָּתֵ֖ף יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And to [the] sons of Kohath he did not give, because the service of the holy [things was] on them; on the shoulder they would carry.

en.L: But to the sons of Kohath he did not give [any], because the service of the holy [things was] on them; on the shoulder they carried [them].
en.B: But he gave none to the Kohathites, because they were responsible for the holy things, which they carried on their shoulders.
en.R: But he did not give any carts to the Levites of Kohath's family. Their work was to take care of the holy things, and they had to carry them on their shoulders.

es.L: Pero a los hijos de Coat no [les] dio, porque el servicio de las [cosas] santas [estaba] sobre ellos; sobre el hombro [las] llevaban.
es.B: Pero a los coatitas no les dio ninguna, porque estaban encargados de las cosas sagradas, que llevaban sobre sus hombros.
es.R: Pero a los levitas de la familia de Coat no les dio carretas. Su trabajo era cuidar las cosas santas, y tenían que llevarlas sobre los hombros.

fr.L: Mais aux fils de Kehath il ne donna [rien], car le service des [choses] saintes [reposait] sur eux ; sur l’épaule ils [les] portaient.
fr.B: Mais il n’en donna pas aux Kehathites, car ils avaient la charge des objets sacrés, qu’ils portaient sur leurs épaules.
fr.R: Mais il n’a pas donné de chariots aux Lévites de la famille de Kehath. Leur travail était de s’occuper des objets saints, et ils devaient les porter sur leurs épaules.

sw.L: Lakini wana wa Kohathi hakuwapa [kitu], kwa sababu huduma ya [vitu] vitakatifu [ilikuwa] juu yao; walivibeba mabegani.
sw.B: Lakini Wakohathi hakuwapa gari lolote, kwa sababu walikuwa na jukumu la vitu vitakatifu, ambavyo walivibeba mabegani mwao.
sw.R: Lakini Walawi wa ukoo wa Kohathi hakuwapa magari. Kazi yao ilikuwa kutunza vitu vitakatifu, na iliwapasa kuvibeba mabegani.

decisions.choice: the Kohathites carried the holy things on their shoulders, not on carts
decisions.reason: The Kohathites carried the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars and the holy utensils, wrapped by the priests and carried on poles (4:4-15). When the ark was later moved on a new cart, the outcome was disaster (2 Samuel 6:3-7), and David then had the Levites carry it on their shoulders "as Moses commanded" (1 Chronicles 15:13-15).

decisions.choice: the service of the holy things was on them: it was their duty
decisions.reason: "Was on them" means it was their task. The verb "carry" is in a form that describes what they did regularly, each time the camp moved.

decisions.choice: gave none / did not give any carts
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he did not give". Balanced and Readable supply what was not given.

source.text: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ הַנְּשִׂאִ֗ים אֵ֚ת חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּקְרִ֧יבוּ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֛ם אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And brought near the leaders the dedication of the altar on [the] day of anointing it, and brought near the leaders their offering before the altar.

en.L: And the leaders presented the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed; and the leaders presented their offering before the altar.
en.B: The leaders also brought offerings for the dedication of the altar at the time it was anointed. They presented their offerings in front of the altar.
en.R: The leaders also brought offerings to dedicate the altar at the time it was anointed. They placed their offerings in front of the altar.

es.L: Y presentaron los jefes la dedicación del altar el día en que fue ungido; y presentaron los jefes su ofrenda delante del altar.
es.B: Los jefes también trajeron ofrendas para la dedicación del altar en el tiempo en que fue ungido. Presentaron sus ofrendas delante del altar.
es.R: Los jefes también trajeron ofrendas para dedicar el altar cuando fue ungido. Pusieron sus ofrendas delante del altar.

fr.L: Et les chefs présentèrent la dédicace de l’autel, le jour où il fut oint ; et les chefs présentèrent leur offrande devant l’autel.
fr.B: Les chefs apportèrent aussi des offrandes pour la dédicace de l’autel, au moment où il fut oint. Ils présentèrent leurs offrandes devant l’autel.
fr.R: Les chefs ont aussi apporté des offrandes pour inaugurer l’autel, au moment où il a été oint. Ils ont déposé leurs offrandes devant l’autel.

sw.L: Na viongozi wakaleta [sadaka za] kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu siku ilipopakwa mafuta; na viongozi wakaleta sadaka yao mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Viongozi pia walileta sadaka kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu wakati ilipopakwa mafuta. Walitoa sadaka zao mbele ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Viongozi pia walileta sadaka ili kuiweka wakfu madhabahu wakati ilipopakwa mafuta. Waliweka sadaka zao mbele ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the dedication of the altar: the gifts that marked the altar's first use
decisions.reason: The word means a dedication or opening, the start of something's use. It is used again for the dedication of Solomon's altar (2 Chronicles 7:9) and of the wall of Jerusalem (Nehemiah 12:27). Here it names both the event and the offerings brought for it (verses 84, 88).

decisions.choice: on the day it was anointed: at the time it was anointed
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, "on the day" sets the time in general: verse 11 spreads the gifts over twelve days, and verse 88 says they came "after it was anointed".

decisions.choice: brought offerings for the dedication
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "presented the dedication". Balanced and Readable say what was presented, offerings for the dedication.

decisions.choice: "la dédicace de l'autel" (L, B); "inaugurer l'autel" (R)
decisions.reason: "Dédicace" is the French word for the dedication of a building or altar for worship, and it is kept for this word through verses 84-88. Readable says "inaugurer", the everyday word for putting something into use for the first time (m1).

decisions.choice: "kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu" (L, B); "kuiweka wakfu madhabahu" (R)
decisions.reason: "Kuweka wakfu" is to set something apart for God's use, the sense of the dedication here (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the noun-like passive, "the being dedicated of the altar"; Readable uses the plain active verb.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַיּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַיּ֔וֹם יַקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֔ם לַחֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Moses, leader one for the day, leader one for the day, they will bring near their offering for [the] dedication of the altar.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "One leader for the day, one leader for the day, they shall present their offering for the dedication of the altar."
en.B: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Moses, "They are to present their offerings for the dedication of the altar one leader each day."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} told Moses, "Each leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar on a day of his own, one leader each day."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a Moisés: «Un jefe por día, un jefe por día, presentarán su ofrenda para la dedicación del altar».
es.B: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Moisés: «Presentarán sus ofrendas para la dedicación del altar un jefe cada día».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Moisés: «Cada jefe debe traer su ofrenda para dedicar el altar en el día que le toque, un jefe cada día».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Un chef par jour, un chef par jour, ils présenteront leur offrande pour la dédicace de l’autel. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Moïse : « Ils présenteront leurs offrandes pour la dédicace de l’autel, un chef chaque jour. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Moïse : « Chaque chef doit apporter son offrande pour l’inauguration de l’autel le jour qui est le sien, un chef par jour. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Kiongozi mmoja kwa siku, kiongozi mmoja kwa siku, wataleta sadaka yao kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu."
sw.B: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Musa, "Watatoa sadaka zao kwa ajili ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu, kiongozi mmoja kila siku."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Musa, "Kila kiongozi alete sadaka yake kwa ajili ya kuiweka wakfu madhabahu katika siku yake mwenyewe, kiongozi mmoja kila siku."

decisions.choice: one leader for the day, one leader for the day: one leader each day
decisions.reason: Saying a phrase twice gives it the sense "each" or "one after another". The leaders came one at a time, on twelve days in a row (verses 12-83).

decisions.choice: they shall present their offering: each leader his own
decisions.reason: "They" are the twelve leaders, and "their offering" is the gift of each in turn. Verses 12-83 show that every leader brought exactly the same offering.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י הַמַּקְרִ֛יב בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ נַחְשׁ֥וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָ֖ב לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was the one bringing near on the day the first his offering Nahshon son of Amminadab, of [the] tribe of Judah.

en.L: And the one who presented his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.
en.B: The one who presented his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, from the tribe of Judah.
en.R: On the first day Nahshon son of Amminadab brought his offering. He was from the tribe of Judah.

es.L: Y el que presentó su ofrenda el primer día fue Naasón hijo de Aminadab, de la tribu de Judá.
es.B: El que presentó su ofrenda el primer día fue Naasón hijo de Aminadab, de la tribu de Judá.
es.R: El primer día, Naasón, hijo de Aminadab, trajo su ofrenda. Era de la tribu de Judá.

fr.L: Et celui qui présenta son offrande le premier jour fut Nahshôn fils d’Amminadab, de la tribu de Juda.
fr.B: Celui qui présenta son offrande le premier jour fut Nahshôn fils d’Amminadab, de la tribu de Juda.
fr.R: Le premier jour, Nahshôn, fils d’Amminadab, a apporté son offrande. Il était de la tribu de Juda.

sw.L: Na yule aliyeleta sadaka yake siku ya kwanza alikuwa Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu, wa kabila la Yuda.
sw.B: Aliyetoa sadaka yake siku ya kwanza alikuwa Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu, kutoka kabila la Yuda.
sw.R: Siku ya kwanza Nashoni mwana wa Aminadabu alileta sadaka yake. Alikuwa wa kabila la Yuda.

decisions.choice: Judah first: the order of the camp
decisions.reason: The tribes come in the order of the camp in chapter 2: Judah, Issachar and Zebulun on the east, then Reuben, Simeon and Gad, then Ephraim, Manasseh and Benjamin, then Dan, Asher and Naphtali (2:3-31). Judah's camp led the march (2:9; 10:14).

decisions.choice: Nahshon son of Amminadab: the leader of Judah
decisions.reason: He is named as Judah's leader in 1:7 and 2:3. His sister Elisheba was Aaron's wife (Exodus 6:23), and he is an ancestor of David (Ruth 4:20-22).

decisions.choice: the one who presented his offering: the opening of the first of twelve matching reports
decisions.reason: The first report is introduced more fully than the rest. From verse 18 on, each report opens only with the day, the leader and his tribe.

source.text: וְקָרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒ מִזְרָ֤ק אֶחָד֙ כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁבְעִ֥ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם׀מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And his offering [was] dish of silver one, thirty and a hundred its weight, basin one [of] silver, seventy shekel[s] by [the] shekel of the holy [place], both of them full [of] fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering,

en.L: And his offering [was] one silver dish, its weight [was] 130 [shekels], one silver basin of seventy shekels by the sanctuary shekel, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering,
en.B: His offering was one silver dish weighing {{units:about 3 1/4 pounds|130 shekels}} and one silver basin weighing {{units:about 1 3/4 pounds by the sanctuary standard|seventy shekels by the sanctuary shekel}}, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering,
en.R: His offering was a silver plate that weighed {{units:about 3 1/4 pounds|130 shekels}} and a silver bowl that weighed {{units:about 1 3/4 pounds by the sanctuary standard|seventy shekels by the sanctuary shekel}}. Both were full of fine flour mixed with oil, for a grain offering.

es.L: Y su ofrenda [fue] un plato de plata, su peso [era de] 130 [siclos], un cuenco de plata de setenta siclos según el siclo del santuario, ambos llenos de flor de harina amasada con aceite para una ofrenda de cereal,
es.B: Su ofrenda fue un plato de plata que pesaba {{units:unos 1,5 kilos|130 siclos}} y un cuenco de plata que pesaba {{units:unos 800 gramos según el peso del santuario|setenta siclos según el siclo del santuario}}, ambos llenos de flor de harina amasada con aceite para una ofrenda de cereal,
es.R: Su ofrenda fue una bandeja de plata que pesaba {{units:unos 1,5 kilos|130 siclos}} y un tazón de plata que pesaba {{units:unos 800 gramos según el peso del santuario|setenta siclos según el siclo del santuario}}. Los dos estaban llenos de la mejor harina mezclada con aceite, para una ofrenda de cereal.

fr.L: Et son offrande [fut] un plat d’argent, son poids [était de] 130 [sicles], un bassin d’argent de soixante-dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire, tous deux pleins de fleur de farine pétrie à l’huile pour une offrande végétale,
fr.B: Son offrande fut un plat d’argent pesant {{units:environ 1,5 kilo|130 sicles}} et un bassin d’argent pesant {{units:environ 800 grammes selon le poids du sanctuaire|soixante-dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}, tous deux pleins de fleur de farine pétrie à l’huile pour une offrande végétale,
fr.R: Son offrande était un plateau en argent qui pesait {{units:environ 1,5 kilo|130 sicles}} et un bol en argent qui pesait {{units:environ 800 grammes selon le poids du sanctuaire|soixante-dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}. Tous deux étaient remplis de la meilleure farine mêlée d’huile, pour une offrande végétale.

sw.L: Na sadaka yake [ilikuwa] sahani moja ya fedha, uzito wake [ulikuwa shekeli] 130, bakuli moja la fedha la shekeli sabini kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu, vyote viwili vimejaa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta kwa sadaka ya nafaka,
sw.B: Sadaka yake ilikuwa sahani moja ya fedha yenye uzito wa {{units:karibu kilo 1.5|shekeli 130}} na bakuli moja la fedha lenye uzito wa {{units:karibu gramu 800 kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli sabini kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}, vyote viwili vimejaa unga laini uliochanganywa na mafuta kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka,
sw.R: Sadaka yake ilikuwa sahani kubwa ya fedha yenye uzito wa {{units:karibu kilo 1.5|shekeli 130}} na bakuli la fedha lenye uzito wa {{units:karibu gramu 800 kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli sabini kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}. Vyote viwili vilijaa unga bora kabisa uliochanganywa na mafuta, kwa ajili ya sadaka ya nafaka.

decisions.choice: a dish and a basin: vessels for the altar's use
decisions.reason: The dish is the kind of wide plate made for the table of the bread of the Presence (Exodus 25:29). The basin is the bowl used for the blood of the offerings, which was splashed against the altar (Exodus 27:3; 24:6). The vessels themselves were part of the gift.

decisions.choice: 130 and seventy shekels by the sanctuary shekel: weights of silver
decisions.reason: The shekel was a weight of about 11.5 grams, or two-fifths of an ounce. "Shekels" is said only once, after "seventy", but the first number is a weight in shekels too (verse 85). The sanctuary shekel was the official standard for things given to the sanctuary (Exodus 30:13), and it covers both weights.

decisions.choice: full of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering
decisions.reason: The vessels came filled with a grain offering of the kind set out in Leviticus 2:1-5: fine flour with olive oil, part of it burned on the altar and the rest given to the priests (Leviticus 2:2-3).

decisions.choice: about 3 1/4 pounds / about 1 3/4 pounds
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the weights in modern measures, rounded, with the shekels as the setting's alternative. Literal keeps the shekels.

decisions.choice: plate / bowl
decisions.reason: Readable uses everyday words for the two vessels. Literal and Balanced keep "dish" and "basin", as in Exodus 25:29 and 27:3.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 1,5 kilos|130 siclos}}; {{units:unos 800 gramos según el peso del santuario|setenta siclos según el siclo del santuario}}
decisions.reason: The weights in metric, from the shekel of about 11.5 g and rounded as the English rounds; the shekels are the alternative, and Literal keeps them. The same spans return in each of the twelve lists.

decisions.choice: "un plato", "un cuenco" (L, B), "una bandeja", "un tazón" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the vessel names used for the tabernacle's dishes and basins; Readable uses everyday words, as the English does. The list is repeated word for word for all twelve leaders, as the Hebrew repeats it.

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 1,5 kilo|130 sicles}}; {{units:environ 800 grammes selon le poids du sanctuaire|soixante-dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}
decisions.reason: The weights in metric, from the shekel of about 11.5 g and rounded as the English rounds (130 shekels about 1.5 kg, seventy about 800 g); the shekels are the alternative, and Literal keeps them. The same spans return in each of the twelve lists.

decisions.choice: "un plat", "un bassin" (L, B), "un plateau", "un bol" (R); "fleur de farine pétrie à l'huile" (L, B), "la meilleure farine mêlée d'huile" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the vessel names of Exodus 25:29 and 27:3; Readable uses everyday words, as the English does. This wording of the list is repeated unchanged for all twelve leaders, as the Hebrew repeats it (verse 17, m3).

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu kilo 1.5|shekeli 130}}; {{units:karibu gramu 800 kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli sabini kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}
decisions.reason: The weights in metric, from the shekel of about 11.5 g and rounded as the English rounds, with the measure after the noun as Swahili writes it; the shekels are the alternative, and Literal keeps them. The same spans return in each of the twelve lists.

decisions.choice: "sahani" and "bakuli" at every level (R "sahani kubwa")
decisions.reason: Swahili's words for a plate and a bowl are already everyday words, so Readable keeps them and only adds that the plate was large (it weighed about 1.5 kg). The list is repeated word for word for all twelve leaders, as the Hebrew repeats it.

source.text: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: pan one [of] ten [shekels of] gold, full [of] incense,

en.L: one pan of ten [shekels of] gold, full of incense,
en.B: one gold pan weighing {{units:about 4 ounces|ten shekels}}, full of incense,
en.R: He also gave a small gold pan that weighed {{units:about 4 ounces|ten shekels}}. It was full of incense.

es.L: una cazoleta de diez [siclos de] oro, llena de incienso,
es.B: una cazoleta de oro que pesaba {{units:unos 115 gramos|diez siclos}}, llena de incienso,
es.R: También dio un platillo de oro que pesaba {{units:unos 115 gramos|diez siclos}}. Estaba lleno de incienso.

fr.L: une coupelle de dix [sicles d’]or, pleine d’encens,
fr.B: une coupelle d’or pesant {{units:environ 115 grammes|dix sicles}}, pleine d’encens,

decisions.choice: the sacrifice of peace offerings: a sacrifice shared in a meal

decisions.reason: Each of the twelve reports ends with this line, naming the leader again. The repeated, identical lists stress that every tribe gave the same, so that each had an equal share in the altar.

decisions.choice: Zebulun third, in the order of the camp

decisions.choice: [it was the] / it was the turn of
decisions.reason: From verse 24 on, each report opens without a verb: only the day, the leader and his name. Literal supplies "it was" in brackets; Balanced and Readable say whose turn it was, as verses 11-12 imply.

decisions.choice: the people of Zebulun / the tribe of Zebulun
decisions.reason: "The sons of Zebulun" means the tribe descended from Zebulun, women as well as men. Balanced writes "people" with "sons" as the setting's alternative; Readable says "tribe". The same holds in each later report.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Zabulón" (L), "el pueblo de Zabulón" (B), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already takes in daughters, so it needs no setting, as with "los hijos de Israel"; Balanced says "el pueblo" for the tribe, as the English does. The same holds in each later report.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Zabuloni" (L), "watu wa Zabuloni" (B), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Swahili "wana" means children of either sex, so it needs no setting; Balanced says "watu" (people) for the tribe, as the English does. The same holds in each later report.

records.literal_gloss: pans of gold two [and] ten, full [of] incense, ten ten the pan by [the] shekel of the holy [place]; all [the] gold of the pans twenty and a hundred.

en.L: twelve gold pans full of incense, ten [shekels] each pan by the sanctuary shekel; all the gold of the pans [was] 120 [shekels].
en.B: and the twelve gold pans full of incense, each weighing {{units:about 4 ounces by the sanctuary standard|ten shekels by the sanctuary shekel}}, so that all the gold of the pans came to {{units:about 3 pounds|120 shekels}}.
en.R: The twelve small gold pans full of incense each weighed {{units:about 4 ounces by the sanctuary standard|ten shekels by the sanctuary shekel}}. All together, the gold of the pans weighed {{units:about 3 pounds|120 shekels}}.

es.L: doce cazoletas de oro llenas de incienso, diez [siclos] cada cazoleta según el siclo del santuario; todo el oro de las cazoletas [fue] 120 [siclos].
es.B: y las doce cazoletas de oro llenas de incienso, que pesaban cada una {{units:unos 115 gramos según el peso del santuario|diez siclos según el siclo del santuario}}, de modo que el oro de las cazoletas sumó {{units:unos 1,4 kilos|120 siclos}}.
es.R: Los doce platillos de oro llenos de incienso pesaban cada uno {{units:unos 115 gramos según el peso del santuario|diez siclos según el siclo del santuario}}. En total, el oro de los platillos pesaba {{units:unos 1,4 kilos|120 siclos}}.

fr.L: douze coupelles d’or pleines d’encens, dix [sicles] chaque coupelle selon le sicle du sanctuaire ; tout l’or des coupelles [fut de] 120 [sicles].
fr.B: et les douze coupelles d’or pleines d’encens, pesant chacune {{units:environ 115 grammes selon le poids du sanctuaire|dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}, si bien que l’or des coupelles s’éleva à {{units:environ 1,4 kilo|120 sicles}}.
fr.R: Les douze petites coupes en or pleines d’encens pesaient chacune {{units:environ 115 grammes selon le poids du sanctuaire|dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire}}. En tout, l’or des coupes pesait {{units:environ 1,4 kilo|120 sicles}}.

sw.L: visahani kumi na viwili vya dhahabu vilivyojaa uvumba, [shekeli] kumi kila kisahani kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu; dhahabu yote ya visahani [ilikuwa shekeli] 120.
sw.B: na visahani kumi na viwili vya dhahabu vilivyojaa uvumba, kila kimoja chenye uzito wa {{units:karibu gramu 115 kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli kumi kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}, hivi kwamba dhahabu ya visahani ilifikia {{units:karibu kilo 1.4|shekeli 120}}.
sw.R: Kila kimoja cha visahani vidogo kumi na viwili vya dhahabu vilivyojaa uvumba kilikuwa na uzito wa {{units:karibu gramu 115 kwa kipimo cha mahali patakatifu|shekeli kumi kwa shekeli ya mahali patakatifu}}. Kwa jumla, dhahabu ya visahani ilikuwa na uzito wa {{units:karibu kilo 1.4|shekeli 120}}.

decisions.choice: ten ten the pan: ten shekels each
decisions.reason: Saying the number twice gives it the sense "each", as "one leader for the day" is said twice in verse 11.

decisions.choice: 120 shekels of gold in all
decisions.reason: Twelve pans of ten shekels make 120 shekels, about 1.4 kilograms of gold.

decisions.choice: and the twelve gold pans
decisions.reason: Balanced joins this verse to the list of verses 84-85 with "and" and the article, since the pans were already named in verse 84.

source.text: כָּל־הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: All the cattle for the burnt offering: young bulls two [and] ten, rams two [and] ten, lambs, sons of a year, two [and] ten, and their grain offering; and male goats of goats two [and] ten for a sin offering,

en.L: All the cattle for the burnt offering [were] twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs, sons of a year, and their grain offering; and twelve male goats of the goats for a sin offering,
en.B: All the animals for the burnt offering were twelve bulls, twelve rams and twelve year-old male lambs, with their grain offering, and there were twelve male goats for a sin offering,
en.R: For the burnt offering the leaders gave twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs one year old, with the grain offerings that went with them. For the sin offering they gave twelve male goats.

es.L: Todo el ganado para el holocausto [fue] doce toros, doce carneros, doce corderos machos, hijos de un año, y su ofrenda de cereal; y doce machos cabríos de entre las cabras como sacrificio por el pecado,
es.B: Todos los animales para el holocausto fueron doce toros, doce carneros y doce corderos machos de un año, con su ofrenda de cereal, y hubo doce machos cabríos como sacrificio por el pecado,
es.R: Para el holocausto los jefes dieron doce toros, doce carneros y doce corderos machos de un año, con las ofrendas de cereal que los acompañaban. Para el sacrificio por el pecado dieron doce machos cabríos.

fr.L: Tout le gros bétail pour l’holocauste [fut] douze taureaux, douze béliers, douze agneaux mâles, fils d’un an, et leur offrande végétale ; et douze boucs d’entre les chèvres en sacrifice pour le péché,
fr.B: Tous les animaux pour l’holocauste furent douze taureaux, douze béliers et douze agneaux mâles d’un an, avec leur offrande végétale, et il y eut douze boucs en sacrifice pour le péché,
fr.R: Pour l’holocauste, les chefs ont donné douze taureaux, douze béliers et douze agneaux mâles d’un an, avec les offrandes végétales qui les accompagnaient. Pour le sacrifice pour le péché, ils ont donné douze boucs.

sw.L: Ng'ombe wote kwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa [walikuwa] mafahali kumi na wawili, kondoo dume kumi na wawili, wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili, wana wa mwaka mmoja, na sadaka yao ya nafaka; na mabeberu kumi na wawili wa mbuzi kuwa sadaka ya dhambi,
sw.B: Wanyama wote kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa walikuwa mafahali kumi na wawili, kondoo dume kumi na wawili na wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili wa mwaka mmoja, pamoja na sadaka yao ya nafaka; tena kulikuwa na mabeberu kumi na wawili kuwa sadaka ya dhambi,
sw.R: Kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa viongozi walitoa mafahali kumi na wawili, kondoo dume kumi na wawili, na wana-kondoo dume kumi na wawili wa mwaka mmoja, pamoja na sadaka za nafaka zilizoambatana nazo. Kwa ajili ya sadaka ya dhambi walitoa mabeberu kumi na wawili.

decisions.choice: all the cattle: all the animals
decisions.reason: The word usually means cattle, but here it heads a list that also has rams and lambs, and in verse 88 goats. It stands for all the animals of each kind of offering.

decisions.choice: their grain offering: the grain offerings that went with the burnt offerings
decisions.reason: This points back to the fine flour in the dishes and basins (verse 13). Grain offerings often went with burnt offerings (Numbers 15:1-12).

decisions.choice: animals
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "cattle". Balanced and Readable say "animals", since the list includes sheep and goats.

source.text: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר׀זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and all [the] cattle of [the] sacrifice of the peace offerings: young bulls twenty and four, rams sixty, male goats sixty, lambs, sons of a year, sixty. This [was the] dedication of the altar after anointing it.

en.L: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of the peace offerings [were] twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, sixty male lambs, sons of a year. This [was] the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.
en.B: and all the animals for the sacrifice of peace offerings were twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty year-old male lambs. This was the offering for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.
en.R: For the sacrifice of peace offerings they gave twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs one year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it had been anointed.

es.L: y todo el ganado para el sacrificio de paz [fue] veinticuatro toros, sesenta carneros, sesenta machos cabríos, sesenta corderos machos, hijos de un año. Esta [fue] la dedicación del altar después de que fue ungido.
es.B: y todos los animales para el sacrificio de paz fueron veinticuatro toros, sesenta carneros, sesenta machos cabríos y sesenta corderos machos de un año. Esta fue la ofrenda para la dedicación del altar después de que fue ungido.
es.R: Para el sacrificio de paz dieron veinticuatro toros, sesenta carneros, sesenta machos cabríos y sesenta corderos machos de un año. Estas fueron las ofrendas para dedicar el altar después de que había sido ungido.

fr.L: et tout le gros bétail pour le sacrifice de communion [fut] vingt-quatre taureaux, soixante béliers, soixante boucs, soixante agneaux mâles, fils d’un an. Telle [fut] la dédicace de l’autel, après qu’il eut été oint.
fr.B: et tous les animaux pour le sacrifice de communion furent vingt-quatre taureaux, soixante béliers, soixante boucs et soixante agneaux mâles d’un an. Telle fut l’offrande pour la dédicace de l’autel, après qu’il eut été oint.
fr.R: Pour le sacrifice de communion, ils ont donné vingt-quatre taureaux, soixante béliers, soixante boucs et soixante agneaux mâles d’un an. Voilà les offrandes apportées pour l’inauguration de l’autel, une fois qu’il avait été oint.

sw.L: na ng'ombe wote kwa dhabihu ya sadaka za amani [walikuwa] mafahali ishirini na wanne, kondoo dume sitini, mabeberu sitini, wana-kondoo dume sitini, wana wa mwaka mmoja. Hiki [ndicho] kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu baada ya kupakwa mafuta.
sw.B: na wanyama wote kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani walikuwa mafahali ishirini na wanne, kondoo dume sitini, mabeberu sitini na wana-kondoo dume sitini wa mwaka mmoja. Hiyo ndiyo iliyokuwa sadaka ya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu baada ya kupakwa mafuta.
sw.R: Kwa ajili ya sadaka ya amani walitoa mafahali ishirini na wanne, kondoo dume sitini, mabeberu sitini, na wana-kondoo dume sitini wa mwaka mmoja. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa sadaka za kuiweka wakfu madhabahu baada ya kupakwa mafuta.

decisions.choice: twenty-four bulls and sixty of each of the others
decisions.reason: These are twelve times the peace offerings of verse 17: two oxen and five each of rams, male goats and lambs. The "oxen" of the single lists are counted here as bulls.

decisions.choice: after it was anointed
decisions.reason: This closes the summary begun in verse 84 and makes clear that the twelve days of gifts followed the anointing of the altar (verse 1).

decisions.choice: animals
decisions.reason: As in verse 87.

source.text: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And when went Moses into [the] tent of meeting to speak with him, and he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat which [was] on [the] ark of the testimony, from between [the] two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

en.L: And when Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that [was] on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to him.
en.B: When Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubim. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to him.
en.R: When Moses went into the meeting tent to talk with God, he heard the voice speaking to him. It came from above the lid of the ark that holds the covenant tablets, from between the two cherubim. That is how God spoke with Moses.

es.L: Y cuando entró Moisés en la Tienda del Encuentro para hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, oyó la voz que le hablaba desde encima del propiciatorio que [estaba] sobre el arca del Testimonio, de entre los dos querubines; y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le habló.
es.B: Cuando Moisés entró en la Tienda del Encuentro para hablar con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, oyó la voz que le hablaba desde encima del propiciatorio que estaba sobre el arca del Testimonio, de entre los dos querubines. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le habló.
es.R: Cuando Moisés entró en la Tienda del Encuentro para hablar con Dios, oyó la voz que le hablaba. Venía de encima de la tapa del arca que guarda las tablas del pacto, de entre los dos querubines. Así fue como Dios habló con Moisés.

fr.L: Et quand Moïse entra dans la tente de la Rencontre pour parler avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, il entendit la voix qui lui parlait d’au-dessus du propitiatoire qui [était] sur l’arche du Témoignage, d’entre les deux chérubins ; et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui parla.
fr.B: Lorsque Moïse entra dans la tente de la Rencontre pour parler avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, il entendit la voix qui lui parlait d’au-dessus du propitiatoire placé sur l’arche du Témoignage, d’entre les deux chérubins. Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui parla.
fr.R: Quand Moïse est entré dans la tente de la Rencontre pour parler avec Dieu, il a entendu la voix qui lui parlait. Elle venait d’au-dessus du couvercle de l’arche qui contient les tables de l’alliance, d’entre les deux chérubins. C’est ainsi que Dieu a parlé avec Moïse.

sw.L: Na Musa alipoingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania ili kusema {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, aliisikia sauti ikisema naye kutoka juu ya kiti cha rehema kilichokuwa juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, kutoka katikati ya makerubi wawili; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akasema naye.
sw.B: Musa alipoingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania ili kuzungumza {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, alisikia sauti ikisema naye kutoka juu ya kiti cha rehema kilicho juu ya sanduku la Ushuhuda, kutoka katikati ya makerubi wawili. Hivyo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akasema naye.
sw.R: Musa alipoingia ndani ya Hema la Kukutania ili kuzungumza na Mungu, alisikia sauti ikisema naye. Sauti hiyo ilitoka juu ya kifuniko cha sanduku lenye vibao vya agano, katikati ya makerubi wawili. Hivyo ndivyo Mungu alivyozungumza na Musa.

decisions.choice: the voice from between the cherubim: the promise of Exodus 25:22 kept
decisions.reason: The LORD had said he would meet Moses and speak with him from above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim on the ark (Exodus 25:22). Now that the tabernacle is set up and dedicated, it happens.

decisions.choice: when Moses went in: the event, which may also describe what happened each time
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the scene with "and when Moses went". It may tell of one occasion, or of what happened whenever Moses went in (compare Exodus 33:7-11). Both fit the verse.

decisions.choice: the voice speaking to him
decisions.reason: The verb form for "speaking" is unusual, one that can mean speaking to oneself or conversing. It stresses that Moses heard the voice itself speaking to him, not a vision. "Him" in "to speak with him" and "he spoke to him" is the LORD, last named in verse 11.

decisions.choice: the mercy seat: the gold cover of the ark
decisions.reason: The word is linked to the verb for making atonement. Blood was sprinkled on it on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:14-15). The cherubim, winged heavenly creatures of gold, stood at its two ends (Exodus 25:17-21).

decisions.choice: to talk with God / That is how God spoke with Moses
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has only "him". Readable names God and Moses so that the reader can follow who is speaking to whom.

decisions.choice: the lid of the ark that holds the covenant tablets
decisions.reason: Readable describes the mercy seat and the ark of the testimony in plain words, as in Exodus 25:17-22.

decisions.choice: preterite "entró", "oyó" (one occasion)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew may tell of one occasion or of what happened each time Moses went in (m2). Spanish must choose: the preterite tells it as the event that followed the dedication; the imperfect ("entraba", "oía") would make it a habit.

decisions.choice: passé simple "entra", "entendit" (one occasion)
alternatives: Et quand Moïse entrait ..., il entendait
decisions.reason: The Hebrew may tell of one occasion or of what happened each time Moses went in (m2). French must choose: the passé simple tells it as the event that followed the dedication; the imparfait ("entrait", "entendait") would make it a habit.
